name: Slack
whatYouLose: Search across all channels and files
prompt: Build a team chat app with: channels and DMs, real-time messaging via WebSockets, message history with timestamps, user avatars, @mentions, emoji reactions, file upload (images), unread badges, and a sidebar channel list. SQLite for messages, Node.js + ws for real-time. Simple auth with username/password.
notes: A basic chat for 5-10 people is very vibecodable. Slack's reliability, search, and integrations are not.
